title: 第一卷 第15章 你是我的人第一卷 第16章 林婉的实力
lines: “小人的厨艺是自己琢磨的！”陈玄连忙道。
“自己琢磨？”林婉挑眉看了一眼陈玄道：“你如今不过十六，自己能够琢磨出这样的厨艺来？菜式会如此之多？还有那名字，比如说东坡肉，这是什么意思？”
陈玄哑然，他没想到林婉居然会追问这样的问题。
很显然，这个世界并没有苏东坡。
他连忙道：“这是我小时候在东边的山坡上琢磨出来的菜式，就这么取名了！”
“如今的你，倒是与我第一次见到你，有所不同了！”林婉淡淡的说道。
她当初找陈玄过去，陈玄第一次见到她，紧张，局促！
但是今日的陈玄，却大方得体。
如果不是长得一模一样，她甚至都会觉得这是两个人。
陈玄没有回答，林婉倒也没有深究，毕竟她对于陈玄了解得也不多。
“你今日表现很好，对于我将军府而言，算是立下了大功！”林婉说道：“但是有一个事情你得记着！”
说着，她一双美眸直勾勾的盯着陈玄道：“你陈玄，是我林婉的人，我知道白浅浅那个女人去后厨找你的想法，但是陈玄你记住了，你只是白浅浅的私人厨子，若是让我发现你和她有其他的关系…”
这个时候，陈玄只感觉这兽车内的空气，仿佛都低了几分。
他心里有点儿心虚，但是嘴上却连忙道：“大夫人放心，小人有分寸！”
“你最好有！”林婉开口，同时周遭那股冰冷的气息逐渐消失！
这让陈玄心中微微松了一口气。
“将你的赏银给我吧！”这个时候，林婉忽然开口道。
“啊！”陈玄一愣，他猛然抬起头看着林婉。
林婉依然是那副淡然的模样，她淡淡的道：“你可知，我明明答应你，那夜之后，给你一百两银子，为何最后只给了你二十两！”
“小人…不知！”陈玄道。
“你也说了，赵凇想要抢你的银子！”林婉道：“如今的你太弱了，根本守不住财，你将银钱放在我这里，我替你管着，你需要之时，随时来找我取便是！”
陈玄依然有些不想上交，他硬着头皮说道：“夫人，小人想要习武，昨日去看了一下，玄级功法差不多要千两纹银，所以…”
林婉淡淡的道：“你立了大功，我许你可入将军府藏书阁挑选一门玄级功法作为奖励！”
听到这话，陈玄的眼睛，陡然亮了起来。
“在你入三品之前，身上最好别有超过千两的银子！匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪！”林婉说着，她伸出了一只手道：“所以，将银票交上来吧！”
陈玄无奈，他只能将怀里的银票递给了林婉。
林婉将银票收起，然后她继续问道：“你可还要其他的奖励？”
陈玄硬着头皮说道：“大夫人，小人…想要我的奴籍契书！”
听到这话，林婉的眼眸微微一眯道：“你想要离开将军府？”
“不是！”陈玄连忙道：“大夫人，小人明白，今日能够得到奖赏，全靠将军府，小人才有这样的机会，但是小人日后想要习武，需要大量的银钱，小人依然是将军府的厨子，但是除此之外，也想做点儿生意，挣些银钱来习武！”

"The villain's cooking skills are all developed by himself!" Chen Xuan said quickly.
"Think about it yourself?" Lin Wan raised her eyebrows and glanced at Chen Xuandao: "You are only sixteen now, how can you figure out such cooking skills by yourself? There will be so many dishes? And the name, such as Dongpo Pork, what does it mean?"
Chen Xuan was dumbfounded. He didn't expect Lin Wan to ask such a question.
Obviously, there is no Su Dongpo in this world.
He quickly said: "This is a dish I came up with on the eastern hillside when I was a child, so I named it that way!"
"You are different now than when I first met you!" Lin Wan said lightly.
She originally went to see Chen Xuan. When Chen Xuan saw her for the first time, he was nervous and awkward!
But Chen Xuan today is generous and decent.
If they didn't look exactly the same, she would even think they were two people.
Chen Xuan didn't answer, and Lin Wan didn't delve into it. After all, she didn't know much about Chen Xuan.
"You performed very well today, and you have made a great contribution to our General's Mansion!" Lin Wan said, "But there is one thing you have to remember!"
As she said that, she stared straight at Chen Xuan with her beautiful eyes and said, "You, Chen Xuan, belong to me, Lin Wan. I know what that woman Bai Qianqian wants to do to find you in the kitchen, but Chen Xuan, remember, you are just Bai Qianqian's personal cook. If I find out that you have other relationships with her..."
At this time, Chen Xuan felt that the air in the beast car seemed to be a little lower.
He felt a little guilty in his heart, but he quickly said: "Don't worry, madam, I have a sense of propriety!"
"You'd better have it!" Lin Wan said, and at the same time, the cold aura around her gradually disappeared!
This made Chen Xuan feel slightly relieved.
"Give me your silver reward!" At this time, Lin Wan suddenly said.
"Ah!" Chen Xuan was stunned. He suddenly raised his head and looked at Lin Wan.
Lin Wan still looked indifferent. She said calmly: "Do you know that I clearly promised you that I would give you one hundred taels of silver after that night, but why did I only give you twenty taels in the end?"
"You villain... I don't know!" Chen Xuandao.
"You also said that Zhao Song wants to steal your money!" Lin Wan said: "You are too weak now and can't keep your money at all. You leave your money with me and I will take care of it for you. When you need it, you can come to me to get it at any time!"
Chen Xuan still didn't want to hand it in, so he said bravely: "Madam, I want to practice martial arts. I went to see it yesterday. The Xuan-level skills cost about a thousand taels of silver, so..."
Lin Wan said calmly: "You have made great achievements, I allow you to enter the General's Mansion Library and choose a Xuan-level skill as a reward!"
Hearing this, Chen Xuan's eyes suddenly lit up.
"Before you enter the third rank, you'd better not have more than a thousand taels of silver with you! A man is not guilty, but he is guilty of having a jade!" Lin Wan said, she stretched out a hand and said: "So, hand over the silver note!"
Chen Xuan had no choice but to hand the banknote in his arms to Lin Wan.
Lin Wan put away the banknote, and then she continued to ask: "Do you want any other rewards?"
Chen Xuan bit the bullet and said: "Madam, this villain... wants my slave deed!"
Hearing this, Lin Wan narrowed her eyes slightly and said, "Do you want to leave the General's Mansion?"
"No!" Chen Xuan said quickly: "Madam, I understand that the reward I can get today is all thanks to the General's Mansion. Only this little man has such an opportunity. However, if I want to practice martial arts in the future, I will need a lot of money. I am still a cook in the General's Mansion, but in addition, I also want to do some business and earn some money to practice martial arts!"
